dedupe_keys.name: thai power system hourly generation demand and cross border flows 2023 2024

description: This data set gives hourly time series of the Thai power system for 2023 and 2024: generation and demand in five regions and power exchanges with neighbouring countries. It was published on Zenodo in September 2025 (version 1.0) by Phumthep Bunnak, who collected the figures from the official website of the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT), the national system operator. Generation and demand are given in megawatts for the North, South, Metropolitan, Central and Northeast regions. Cross-border columns give imports from and exports to Malaysia and Laos (Electricité du Laos), imports from the Hongsa thermal power plant in Laos, and exports to Cambodia (Electricité du Cambodge). Coverage is Thailand and its interconnections with Laos, Cambodia and Malaysia. Files are one CSV per year, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: values are collected from published operator figures, not an official data release, and only two years are covered. Simulation uses are regional dispatch and transmission models of Thailand, validating power system models of mainland Southeast Asia and studying cross-border trade. Related records: data-india-state-daily-electricity-demand is a comparable national demand series.
name: Thai power system hourly generation, demand and cross-border flows (2023-2024)
